conditional_theorem: s positive, s=1 mod4; p prime, p=1 mod4; c_s nonzero and p does not divide s*c_s imply c_(sp) nonzero and v_p(c_(sp))=floor(3*s*(p-1)/8).
prime_specialization: For every prime ell=1 mod4, v_ell(c_ell)=floor(3*(ell-1)/8).
optional_clarifications: Construct good upper prime via residue map zeta_(sp)->omega_bar, or mention Frobenius when lower root generator is fixed.
unproved: Uniform absence of prime support outside d.
